title: onboarding repair: npm install in quickstart, brain.md dist path + experimental framing, "Run the loop" in README + generated claude-md routing block (R13 + R14)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) MEDIUM findings R13 (F25+F26+F49) + R14 (F36+F24), adversarially confirmed. (a) README.md:113-117 instructs clone → cd → node bin/init.js with no npm install; bin/init.js transitively imports ajv (src/task-store.js:34), so the very first onboarding command dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND (README:182-184 admits the requirement only in the maintainer section). (b) commands/brain.md:19 runs node bin/brain-launch.js — the ONLY repo-relative command path, broken on plugin installs — and still recommends the TASK-079-demoted brain with no experimental label. (c) README has zero loop/unattended mentions and its first-chat script (:78-87) teaches manual per-ticket confirmation — the product's primary surface is undiscoverable. (d) src/claude-md.js:75-76 hardcodes unconditional 'Tests first' into user-project CLAUDE.md (contradicting the tier policy), twice references state/README.md which init never materializes, and dev-repo CLAUDE.md Principle 4 is unqualified by loop_auth standing grants. Tier is tests-after (not uat-only) because src/claude-md.js is source — its generated-block change gets a regression lock; the human-observable README/commands ACs get the UAT step. Full context: synthesis §R13 §R14.
acceptance_criteria: README First-time setup includes npm install before node bin/init.js (or routes the quickstart through the zero-install dist bundle) — a fresh-clone walkthrough no longer dies with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
commands/brain.md invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/brain-launch.cjs and frames the brain as experimental opt-in (TASK-079 demotion), no longer recommending it for every knowledge-heavy session.

README gains a 'Run the loop' section covering goal syntax, the five gates, and the unattended preset; dev-repo CLAUDE.md points at it and Principle 4 is qualified with 'unless a standing loop_auth authorization covers the action'.

The src/claude-md.js generated routing block reflects the tier policy (no unconditional 'Tests first'), mentions /hivemind:loop, and drops or materializes its state/README.md references — with a regression lock on the generated block.
UAT script derived from the ACs above is run with the human (or delegated), covering the fresh-clone first command and README discoverability.

comments.body: UAT run 2026-07-07, delegated to the Orchestrator under the human's standing uat_delegated_to_orchestrator grant (re-stated 2026-07-07). Script derived from ACs, executed against a fresh git clone of a04a8c9 in an isolated scratch dir. Step 1 (AC1 fresh-clone quickstart): expected clone → npm install → node bin/init.js completes without ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND; observed README:107 now carries npm install with a why-note, install added 148 packages, node bin/init.js exited 0 (already-initialized one-liner, correct for a dev-repo clone) — PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Step 2 (AC2 brain.md): expected experimental/opt-in framing + ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/brain-launch.cjs invocation; observed experimental-opt-in framing at brain.md:9 citing TASK-079, dist path at :22 (health command) and :39 (lifecycle note), no bin/brain-launch.js reference — PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Step 3 (AC3 README discoverability): expected a Run-the-loop section covering goal syntax, five gates, unattended preset; observed section at README:135 with unattended coverage, gate summary, pointer to commands/loop.md, plus first-chat section:82 cross-referencing it — PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Step 4 (AC4 generated routing block): expected no unconditional Tests-first, three tiers named, /hivemind:loop mentioned, no state/README.md refs; observed in a freshly scaffolded project's CLAUDE.md (bin/init.js --answers-file --claude-md-consent): 0 Tests-first matches, tdd/tests-after/uat-only 2 mentions each, 1 /hivemind:loop mention, 0 state/README.md refs — PASS, verified by Orchestrator at the human's request. Note: CLAUDE.md generation is consent-gated (--claude-md-consent), by design (TASK-025 channel separation); without the flag init writes PROJECT.md + bundle only. OVERALL: PASS 4/4, every AC with a human-observable surface covered. Review (rev-102, full depth) runs separately; close awaits its verdict.
